criteria.label: Belief in art’s importance
criteria.definition: Personal view that art matters, rather than only liking a particular work.
criteria.high_evidence: Regards art as important or worth a place in people’s lives.
criteria.low_evidence: Regards art as unimportant or of little value.
criteria.mixed_or_null: Disliking a work does not negate believing art matters; prestige/knowledge alone does not prove belief. Null means absent/inapplicable evidence;0 requires actual mixed/balanced evidence.

criteria.label: Visual art and museums
criteria.definition: Liking/disliking visual art and enjoying/not enjoying museums.
criteria.high_evidence: Enjoys visual works or museum encounters for their aesthetic experience.
criteria.low_evidence: Dislikes visual art or does not enjoy museum encounters.
criteria.mixed_or_null: A critical opinion of one work can coexist with broad enjoyment. Lack of physical access alone is ambiguous. Null means absent/inapplicable evidence;0 requires actual mixed/balanced evidence.

criteria.label: Music and concerts
criteria.definition: Liking music and concert experiences as music.
criteria.high_evidence: Enjoys listening or concert performances for their sound.
criteria.low_evidence: Dislikes music or concert performances, or reports little musical pleasure.
criteria.mixed_or_null: Crowds/loudness/status can coexist, but attending only to accompany friends is not musical enjoyment. Null means absent/inapplicable evidence;0 requires actual mixed/balanced evidence.

criteria.label: Ordinary, flower and natural beauty
criteria.definition: Noticing/savoring beauty in ordinary things, flowers and nature.
criteria.high_evidence: Reports beauty or pleasure in small details, flowers or natural forms.
criteria.low_evidence: Reports little such appreciation or dislike/indifference to these forms.
criteria.mixed_or_null: Environmental concern and botanical knowledge alone are insufficient; these keyed forms are retained within one dimension. Null means absent/inapplicable evidence;0 requires actual mixed/balanced evidence.

criteria.label: Poetry
criteria.definition: Enjoyment or dislike of verse as an aesthetic form.
criteria.high_evidence: Enjoys poetry’s language, rhythm, images or experience.
criteria.low_evidence: Dislikes poetry or reports little pleasure from verse.
criteria.mixed_or_null: Vocabulary and comprehension are neighbors; understanding a poem without enjoying it can be low. Null means absent/inapplicable evidence;0 requires actual mixed/balanced evidence.

criteria.label: Watching dance
criteria.definition: Aesthetic interest/enjoyment in observing dance performance.
criteria.low_evidence: Dislikes or does not enjoy watching dance.
criteria.mixed_or_null: Dance skill, exercise and performing alone do not establish watching enjoyment. Null means absent/inapplicable evidence;0 requires actual mixed/balanced evidence.

boundary_controls.definition: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
One-off access/role/ability constraints alone are ambiguous, not a blanket exclusion of explicit target habits.
Belief in art’s importance can differ from enjoyment. Self-described aesthetic experience counts as portrayal.
Expertise, O1/O5, E2/E5 and environmental ethics may coexist; identifiable keyed enjoyment/dislike remains.

evidence_allocation_policy: Allocate each exact passage to its best-fitting substantive primary dimension; overlapping slots remain null unless a genuinely distinct clause or evidence supports them. Within-dimension item subcontents share one grade. Contradictory subcontents require explicit mixed/qualified interpretation. These are guidance and diagnostics, not new eligibility/invalidation gates.
